lastCompletedStory.title: Write ADR-0050 (GATESHIP supersedes GARBOARD) and append the supersession note to ADR-0049

nextStoryContext: ADR-0050 supersedes ADR-0049 in full: product name is now Gateship (was Garboard), binary rename to `gateship` deferred to launch packaging, no typed alias chosen yet (re-decided at packaging stage), CAM_*/cam internal contracts unchanged (ADR-0045 reaffirmed). ADR-0049 was appended-only (a single supersession block at EOF, no other edits) and its append-only-prefix-of-main invariance pin still holds. docs/positioning.md and the README differentiation section (CAM-331) remain out of scope for this docs-only cycle and are explicitly noted in ADR-0050 as blocked-on-this-landing-first; a future story picking those up should cite ADR-0050, not re-litigate naming. No code/binary/template renamed in this story.
